descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-18 Billing Suggestion · S23 Billing card, retry state and the custom-template form pass axe (WCAG 2 A/AA)

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 A code is always shown, with the elements (Problem, Data, Risk) and the quotes from the note underneath, presented as a suggestion for the physician to verify. … (UAT TC-18; TFA-92596 AC 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92596 ready for pr
  • U8 Creating a custom template requires a note-type selection (one of the 8 pilot templates or 'Procedure / other'); the template cannot be saved without one (step 3). (UAT TC-18; TFA-92599 AC 8; TFA-92599 How it works 6) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U15 If the billing call fails, the call is retried automatically, the note is still shown and the billing area shows a clear error with a way to retry; … (UAT Empty & Failure States (Billing suggestion failed); UAT 3.5; TFA-94745 AC 4)

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Post-Round with a stored billing suggestion (Hospital and Nursing Home), the error / retry state, and the Create Note Template form; the discharge time prompt once built

When Visual lane runs axe on each state

Then No WCAG 2 A/AA violations; the retry and time-choice controls are buttons with accessible names; the card is announced politely

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): axe-core violations = 0 (visual-checks.ts); accessible names present for the retry and time-choice buttons

Where it ran: local visual lane (screenshots + axe); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (blocked)

S23 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-18.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane visual.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); secondary: FAULT · Fault injection — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: visual.
